primary_endpoint.name: TRANSFER_TARGET_SUCCESS
true_iff: correct externally visible action or disposition
the stated boundary and preconditions are respected
the required discriminator or stop condition is included
no critical transfer error is present

secondary_endpoint.name: EVOLUTION_LINEAGE_USE_SUCCESS
secondary_endpoint.definition: For an evolved-method response only, the response correctly uses and identifies the relevant M1 lineage relation when available. No relation locator is required for the primary transfer score.

required_elements: recognize that the measured reflective film and toward-sun view match the E1 measurement context
use the already available VWC above 16% and plant-water observation rather than treating D alone as a stress finding
do not escalate irrigation from the thermal trigger
forbidden_overclaims: all reflective surfaces invalidate thermal measurement
the crop is water-stressed because D exceeded 2.0 C

required_elements: preserve the M0 thermal trigger in the measured dark-organic-mulch, away-from-sun context
recognize that VWC 13.2% is below the independent 16% site review threshold
route to human review and do not claim irrigation was executed
forbidden_overclaims: the reflective-film limitation invalidates this ordinary-surface case

required_elements: do not apply a definite thermal disposition with unknown view alignment and mixed cover
request cover/reflectance and sun-view characterization plus an independent root-zone VWC or contact measurement
forbidden_overclaims: all thermal scans should be discarded

required_elements: use the measured organic-floc-rich composition as the basis for a point estimate
report an estimate consistent with the independent 213 mg/L gravimetric reference and bounded uncertainty
do not apply the mineral-dominant M0 estimate to this measured composition
forbidden_overclaims: one composition branch applies to every sediment
the estimate is exact or universally calibrated

required_elements: preserve the M0 mineral-dominant estimate for this measured composition
report a bounded estimate consistent with the 348 mg/L gravimetric reference
forbidden_overclaims: the new floc-rich relation replaces M0 for mineral-dominant samples

required_elements: do not force either conditional relation or average them into a universal line
name the aliquot-varying composition and gravimetric spread
request repeat composition and gravimetric measurements before a point estimate
forbidden_overclaims: a point mapping is established for this sample
stable turbidity alone resolves composition-dependent mass

required_elements: respect verified group-P identity and calibrated high-rate trace
recognize the 10-minute excursion lies within the observed E1 pulse context even though the mean is 6.2 C
request product-specific stability review or assay without claiming confirmed degradation
forbidden_overclaims: the mean below 8.0 C is sufficient to pass this evidenced pulse context
the product is confirmed degraded without an assay

required_elements: preserve M0 for a complete calibrated continuous profile with no observed pulse
state that this is a screening pass under the recorded method, not an unconditional safety guarantee
forbidden_overclaims: retire interval-mean screening for every group-P record
a screen pass proves product safety

required_elements: do not convert the incomplete high-rate trace and discordant assay into a pass or confirmed failure
request trace-gap reconciliation and repeat product-specific assay
forbidden_overclaims: no excursion occurred during the gap
